一些末梢能响应可能伤害组织的刺激，把它转换成神经信号。这一步还不能等同于疼痛体验: Some endings respond to potentially tissue-damaging stimuli and convert them into nerve signals. This is not yet the same thing as a pain experience.
跟着暖色路径看：电活动沿感觉神经传入脊髓。它不是把一粒疼痛从皮肤运走。: Follow the warm-colored route: electrical activity travels along a sensory nerve into the spinal cord. It does not transport a particle of pain from the skin.
脊髓内，联系分成两路: Connections branch within the spinal cord
绿色支路经脊髓回路联系运动神经；紫色通路同时继续向脑传递。两条都在工作。: The green branch connects through spinal circuits to motor nerves. The purple route continues toward the brain at the same time. Both are working.
肌肉可以先带来缩回动作: Muscle can begin a withdrawal movement
这是保护性反射，不必先作出“我要缩手”的决定。图上向脑通路仍在继续。: This protective reflex need not await a decision to pull your hand away. The ascending route in the diagram is still continuing.
脑内加工，与疼痛体验有关: Brain processing contributes to pain experience
多个脑区共同参与感觉与情绪等加工。疼痛不是一个神经信号，也不是伤害大小的精确读数: Several brain regions participate in sensory and emotional processing. Pain is not one nerve signal or an exact measure of tissue damage.
跟随皮肤、神经、脊髓与大脑之间的信号，区分保护性反射与疼痛体验。: Follow signals between skin, nerves, spinal cord and brain, and distinguish a protective reflex from the experience of pain.
身体里的消息 · 感觉与保护: Messages in the body · Feeling and protection
手为什么有时先缩回来，随后才清楚地觉得疼？把一瞬间放慢，看看身体里同时发生的两件: Why does a hand sometimes pull back before we clearly notice pain? Slow down a moment and watch two things happening in the body together.
从皮肤出发，在脊髓分路: From skin to a spinal branch
教学慢放 · 非真实计时: Teaching slow motion · Not real timing
放大的皮肤末梢经传入神经到脊髓，一支经过运动神经到肌肉，另一支向脑传递。: Enlarged skin endings connect through a sensory nerve to the spinal cord. One branch reaches muscle through motor nerves; another continues toward the brain.
连线把不同位置的组织放到同一张观察图上。彩点表示信号传递，不是沿神经移动的疼痛小: Lines connect tissues from different locations in one observation diagram. Colored dots indicate signal transmission, not balls of pain moving along nerves.
哪一支可以先带来动作？: Which branch can lead to movement first?
其他路径只会变淡，身体并没有把它关掉。: Other routes become dimmer; the body has not switched them off.
查看信号经过的阶段: Inspect stages along the signal routes
屏幕上用一个可能伤害组织的情景，观察身体怎样传递消息。: Use a potentially harmful situation on screen to see how the body transmits information.
只操作屏幕。不要用热、针刺或夹捏来试验疼痛。身体真的不舒服时，告诉照顾你的大人。: Use only the screen. Do not test pain with heat, needles or pinching. If your body feels unwell, tell an adult who cares for you.
一些神经末梢能对可能伤害组织的刺激作出反应。这叫伤害性感受，和一个人体验到的疼痛: Some nerve endings respond to stimuli that could harm tissue. This is nociception, which is distinct from a person’s experience of pain.
缩手不必等一次决定: Withdrawal need not await a decision
脊髓里的回路可以联系肌肉，产生保护性反射。同时，信息也沿其他神经通路传向脑。: Spinal circuits can connect to muscle and produce a protective reflex. Information also travels toward the brain along other neural routes.
疼痛不是伤口尺子: Pain is not a wound ruler
疼痛与身体状态、注意、情绪和过去经历有关。看不见伤口，也不能断定别人没有疼痛。: Pain relates to bodily state, attention, emotions and past experiences. An absence of visible injury cannot tell us that someone has no pain.
身体的警报，也需要被照顾: The body’s warning needs care too
疼痛常常提醒我们停一停、保护身体，但它有时会在组织恢复后持续。疼痛很真实，不能只: Pain often prompts us to pause and protect the body, but it can sometimes persist after tissue has healed. Pain is real. A diagram cannot identify its cause, and enduring pain does not prove bravery.
深入看：信号、反射和体验: A closer look: signals, reflexes and experience
末梢把适宜的刺激转换成电活动，沿感觉神经传入。脊髓内的神经元通过突触联系；缩回反: Nerve endings convert relevant stimuli into electrical activity that travels along sensory nerves. Neurons connect through synapses within the spinal cord. Withdrawal involves interneurons and motor neurons, rather than a single wire pulling muscle directly from skin. Ascending pathways also have several relays. The two branches summarize these connections while omitting crossings, descending modulation and many cells.
本例展示一种急性保护性反应。图上的先后顺序帮助比较支路，不给出固定潜伏期，不适用: This example shows one acute protective response. Its sequence helps compare branches; it specifies no fixed latency and does not represent every pain or reflex. Dragging backward reviews the demonstration, rather than reversing bodily signals. There is no conversion between stimulus intensity, tissue damage and pain scores.
原生 SVG 教学插画；组织、颜色、数量、长度和时间均经简化。它不是诊断工具，也: An original SVG teaching illustration, with simplified tissues, colors, counts, lengths and timing. It is not a diagnostic tool and does not simulate disease, treatment or injury experiments.
两条线概括许多神经元的联系；彩点不是“疼痛小球”。: The two lines summarize many neural connections; the dots are not little balls of pain.
把不同位置的组织并排放大；彩点表示活动前沿，路径长度、细胞形状和时间都不按实际比: Tissues from different locations are enlarged side by side. Colored dots mark activity fronts; path lengths, cell shapes and timing are not to scale.
皮肤里的末梢发现危险线索，发出消息。这还不是“疼”。: Endings in the skin detect possible danger and send a message. That is not yet pain.
高阈值感受末梢可把可能损伤组织的刺激转成神经活动，这一步称为伤害性感受（noci: High-threshold sensory endings can convert potentially tissue-damaging stimuli into neural activity. This is nociception.
画面是一个急性皮肤情景；没有标定刺激温度、强度或组织损伤。: This is an acute skin example; stimulus temperature, intensity and tissue injury are not calibrated.
消息沿感觉神经传到脊髓。跟着暖色线看它往哪里去。: The message travels along a sensory nerve to the spinal cord. Follow the warm-colored line.
感觉神经元的活动沿传入纤维进入脊髓，途中不是搬运一颗“疼痛粒子”。: Activity in a sensory neuron travels along an afferent fiber into the spinal cord; it does not carry a particle of pain.
动画进度不代表真实传导速度；不同纤维与回路有不同延迟。: Animation progress does not represent conduction speed; different fibers and circuits have different delays.
到了脊髓，消息一边能去指挥肌肉，一边继续往脑走。: At the spinal cord, the message can help activate muscle while information continues toward the brain.
脊髓神经元通过突触联系中间神经元和运动神经元；另一些上行通路经多级中继传向脑。: Spinal neurons connect through synapses with interneurons and motor neurons; other ascending pathways relay information toward the brain in several stages.
两条线是功能概括，省略了神经交叉、更多中继及来自脑的调节。: The two lines summarize functions and omit crossings, further relays and descending modulation from the brain.
肌肉收缩，手可以先缩开，不必等脑先下一个决定。: Muscle contracts and the hand can pull away without waiting for a conscious decision.
示例中的保护性缩回由脊髓回路驱动肌肉；同时上行活动仍在继续。: In this example, a spinal circuit drives the protective withdrawal while ascending activity continues.
这是可发生的顺序，不是每次疼痛或每种反射都遵守的固定计时。: This sequence can occur; it is not a fixed timetable for every pain experience or reflex.
脑会结合这些消息和身体的情况。疼不疼、怎么疼，是人的真实感受。: The brain integrates these messages with the body's state. Whether and how it hurts is a real personal experience.
疼痛是一种感觉和情绪体验，涉及多处脑区与生物、心理、社会因素；不能仅由感觉神经活: Pain is a sensory and emotional experience involving several brain regions and biological, psychological and social factors; it cannot be inferred from sensory-neuron activity alone.
疼痛不是伤口大小的尺子；无可见损伤也不能否定一个人报告的疼痛。: Pain is not a ruler for wound size; a lack of visible injury does not negate a person's report of pain.
